description: Sales Engineer / Solutions Engineer  -  technical pre-sale owner (demos, POCs, technical objections): discovery→demo mapping (Gap Selling current/future-state map + 6 demo-design exit criteria + upfront contract + 60/40 rule; SPIN retained) + demo design + delivery (4-beat impact-first arc: quantify problem → show outcome → reverse into the how → close with proof; aha-moment test; audience tailoring; interaction points; 'show me X' triage; standalone demo environment + anonymized data + offline backup; 2h recap SLA) + call-type scripts with scene timings (discovery 30 / first demo 30-45 / technical deep-dive 45-60 / executive overview 20-30; 40-min Solaris default retained) + POC scoping + execution (one-sentence scope test, written success-criteria table, explicit in/out scope, 2-3 week hard timebox with day skeleton, mandatory midpoint checkpoint, GO/NO-GO decision gate, results documentation; 6 entry requirements retained) + technical objection decode playbook (stated question → real question → response, 9 plays, never-bluff doctrine, proof-point pairing, AECR for non-technical) + competitive technical positioning (FIA battlecards: Fact/Impact/Act; winning/battling/losing zones; landmine-question legitimacy test; retained acknowledge-strengths doctrine) + RFP/RFI response (3-5 win themes before writing, swap-the-name test, exec-summary-first, compliance-floor-not-ceiling; comply/limit/custom/decline + qualification retained) + security questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ/VSA/SOC 2/DPA retained; paper process started parallel to POC, never after verbal win) + MEDDIC/MEDDPICC qualification (retained verbatim per 2026-06-08 reversal) + evaluation notes per deal + handoff to delivery-lead (SOW-input packet, kickoff attendance, <10% sold-vs-delivered deviation). Distinct from Outreach Specialist (cold) / Customer Success (post-sale) / Delivery Lead (engagement execution) / AE (closing). White-label voice: 'I', never 'we'.

METHODOLOGY (2026-06-13, web-research synthesis): the running-the-motion depth on top of the owned MEDDIC/BANT frameworks  -  Gong 67,149-demo study (winning demos ~47min via dialogue not monologue; 76-sec no-monologue rule; 21% more speaker switches; solution-mapping in discovery-pain priority order; the 47-min agenda + Show-Tell-Ask + 5 deal-killers), SPICED discovery prompts, multi-threading data (multi-thread +130% win on $50K+, SE-in-room +30%, separate role-specific sessions), technical-buyer playbook (verify tech-fit pre-book, ungated interactive demos, Gartner 61% rep-free), proposal-to-close discipline (compress to signature, 5+ touches, never 'I'll send materials'), AI-usage +77% revenue. Gate 0 PASS: had qualification frameworks but not the quantified demo mechanics, SPICED prompts, multi-thread data, or technical-buyer motion. -> discovery-demo-multithread-2026.md
